class.name: MaszynaSwitchAction
class.description: Sets its switches to one track (switch_event, [code]Event.cpp:1822-1893[/code]), with the blade speed and the second blade's delay it may carry ([code]TTrack::Switch()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:1752-1762[/code]); a negative one leaves the switch's own. Its turntables are unlocked or locked ([MaszynaTurntableServer], [code]Track.cpp:1787-1833[/code]).

method.name: set_switches
method.description: The switches go to [member active_track] with [member blade_speed] and [member blade_delay], the [member turntables] are unlocked or locked - what running the event does, and what the scenery's load does to an event setting state 0 with a delay ([code]switch_event::init()[/code], [code]Event.cpp:1834-1842[/code]).

members.member: The track the switches are set to.
How far past its travel the second blade goes on [m]; negative for the switch's own.
How fast the blades move [m/s]; negative for the switch's own.
Whether the [member turntables] are unlocked - by any state but 0 ([code]Track.cpp:1789[/code]) - or locked.
